evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: one large ochre and rust triangle split into about six pieces at centre; by shot-08s roughly 60 tiles fill the triangle and by shot-20s around 200 tiles, so the substitution growth is visible on screen.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one flat layer of flat-filled tiles with thin graphite edges and a small unlabelled two-bar corner chart; no lighting, depth or material change from shot-02s to shot-20s, so ambition stays modest.
evidence.craft: shot-20s: dense flat ochre and rust tiles with consistent thin edges and no visible overlaps or gaps at full size; the warm cream ground suits the palette, but the corner bars are identical in all three shots.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: a Penrose kite and dart patch in ochre and rust on cream; the cream ground resembles anchor-04, but the substitution tiling itself is not present in any anchor strip.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: the small patch sits right of centre with the corner bars unchanged; by shot-20s the triangle fills the frame and resolves into a dense patch, but there is no visible pull-back as the storyboard describes.
